deployments_detail.use: BEES B2B digital platform uses AI/ML for personalized product recommendations, demand prediction and customer relationship management across markets
Beck's Autonomous — beer recipe, packaging and full marketing campaign generated entirely by AI

BEES ML-powered order generation and personalization: the B2B e-commerce platform uses machine learning to create one-to-one sales proposals and product recommendations for retailers; CEO Michel Doukeris stated 75% of orders are generated by machine learning across 27 countries and 3.8M monthly active users. [AB InBev (BEES, in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 75% of orders generated by machine learning; $11.7B GMV

deployments_detail.use: Beck's Autonomous - AI-created beer where generative AI produced the recipe, the name, the logo/packaging design and the full marketing campaign (imagery and 360 video); launched as a limited-edition product. [OpenAI ChatGPT, Midjourney]

'Abandoned Nights' generative-AI personalized retargeting campaign for TaDa e-commerce platform (Corona, Budweiser): creates personalized cart-abandonment videos delivered via email, SMS, WhatsApp and push, launching in Mexico. [OpenAI (scripts), Replicate (images), ElevenLabs (voice), Imposium/R/GA (video)]

Alehouse Creative - marketing AI tool that analyzes advertising performance history to give real-time insight on creative changes and auto-generates ad variations (imagery, text, product placement) so creatives focus on storytelling. [AB InBev (Beer Garage, in-house)]
Machine learning for brewing quality and manufacturing optimization (Google Cloud/Pluto7), claimed improvement in production runs

BEES Vision - AI-powered image recognition that turns in-store execution photos into actionable intelligence; plus AI-generated sales territories, delivery routes and visit plans (Smart Planning/Routing/Tasking) in the BEES intelligence layer. [AB InBev (BEES.ai, in-house)]

SenseAI (SensAI) - machine learning system that analyzes real-time brewing data (CO2 levels, fermentation times, stage durations) to predict final beer quality and flavor, complementing human tasters; deployed in AB InBev breweries. [AB InBev (Beer Garage, in-house)]

Beer filtration (K Filter) optimization using machine learning on Google Cloud to predict optimal filtration parameters; analyzed 6 months of data and 50+ parameters, first deployed at Newark brewery then scaled across US breweries. [Google Cloud (TensorFlow, Cloud ML Engine, BigQuery), Pluto7]
deployments_detail.value: 60% increase in barrelage per run; 40-50% increase in filter run length

deployments_detail.use: AI-driven touchless supply chain planning on o9 Solutions platform, unifying demand, supply and inventory planning; rolled out to 10 nations covering 75% of global volume, with 85% of US demand plans now touchless. [o9 Solutions]
deployments_detail.value: 85% touchless demand plans (US); forecast accuracy +11pp to 87%; inventory -20%

deployments_detail.use: BEES Fintech credit scoring: machine learning and algorithms assess creditworthiness of small retailers to extend short-term credit more widely with lower risk, cutting loan approval time from ~two weeks to hours. [AB InBev (BEES Fintech, in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: 500,000+ users using short-term credit; approval time cut from ~2 weeks to hours

deployments_detail.use: Intelligent automation for order-error resolution: SS&C Blue Prism digital workers combined with NLP and conversational AI create CRM tickets, extract order details and trigger automated customer communications so customers correct erroneous orders in real time. [SS&C Blue Prism]
